notes.title: Springs Of Ardor - Version 1.1 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We've just rolled out version 1.1 of Springs of Ardor.
With this update we add more sexy content to the game and expand on the lore of the springs a bit more. Also included are fixes to some minor goofs that were in the game.

Please note; The scenes between Noah and Mateo/Juan require you to have made certain choices in the game, for them to appear. Thus you might need to load an "early in the game" save to achieve those scenes.

Hope you guys like it :)

Timo & Hadrian.
FullFrontal


Added 33 images scene of Noah and Mateo on an excursion.
Added 39 images scene of Noah and Juan on a morning walk through the reserve.
Added 16 images scene of Noah and a surprise visitor at the resort.
Added 13 images scene of Noah and a resort guest.
Added 4 new steam achievements.
Changes were made to the second quest. (Cleaning the room)
Minor fixes through out the game.

notes.title: New scene's coming with the next update.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We just wanted to take a moment to give a massive shout-out to each and every one of you who has supported us by purchasing our first steam game. Your support means the world to us, and we couldn't be more grateful for your enthusiasm and encouragement!

It's been amazing to see all the feedback pouring in. We've been reading every comment, review, and messages you’ve sent our way. Your thoughts and suggestions are invaluable, and they truly help us make this, but also our future games even better. 

We're excited to announce that we're currently hard at work on an update to Springs of Ardor. This update is going to include some awesome new scenes that we think you’re going to love. We’re pouring our hearts into making sure these new additions are top-notch and add even more fun and excitement to Springs of Ardor. We aim to release this update around/near the end of July.

Stay tuned for more details coming soon and make sure to follow us on X, @fullfrontalbeef to receive early previews. We can't wait to share what we've been working on with you!


Once again, thank you for all your support and feedback. 


Much love,

FullFrontalBeef
Timo & Hadrian
